title: Peruvian Chicken Causa Limena
description: A traditional Peruvian dish featuring juicy chicken, full fat sour cream, and a blend of spices, all on a bed of crispy potatoes, perfect for a comforting dinner
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Wash and peel the potatoes, then cut them into 1 inch cubes
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with salt and pepper
Roast the potatoes in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown
While the potatoes are cooking, season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and paprika
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat, add the chicken breast, and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until it is cooked through
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly
In a blender or food processor, combine the sour cream, onion, garlic, and aji amarillo pepper, and blend until smooth
To assemble the Causa Limena, place a layer of potatoes on a plate, followed by a layer of sliced chicken, and then a spoonful of the sour cream mixture
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of potatoes on top
Place the plate under the broiler for 2 minutes, or until the top layer of potatoes is crispy and golden brown
